title: Printable grid with a house and a masjid
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 2: Statistics; position and direction; shape; assessment
source: Seeded from mathematics/y2 lesson 72 (Printable grid with a house and a masjid)
intro: Lesson 72: Describe position: left, right, up and down. To understand how to describe position and movement on a grid

questions.q: Describe a route from the house to the masjid.
questions.a: For example: 4 squares right, then 4 squares up

questions.model: Teacher moves the counter, counting each square.

questions.q: Write the moves from the house to the masjid on the grid sheet.
Find a different route of the same length.
Big question: how can we give clear directions?
questions.a: Say how many squares and which direction, one step at a time.
